title: 과거 시제 vs 현재완료(have p.p.)
goal: 끝난 때를 말하면 과거 시제, 지금과 연결되면 현재완료로 골라 쓸 수 있어요.

points.title: 과거 시제 = 끝난 때를 콕 집을 때
points.body: yesterday, last week, two days ago, in 2022처럼 '언제'가 분명한 끝난 일은 과거 시제로 말해요. I arrived in Sydney last week.

points.title: 현재완료 = 지금과 연결될 때
points.body: 언제인지 말하지 않고, 그 일이 지금과 이어질 때(경험·결과·계속) have / has + p.p.를 써요. I have lost my phone.(잃어버려서 지금 없어요)

points.title: ago, yesterday, last ~, When ~?
points.body: 이런 말은 끝난 과거를 가리키니까 현재완료와 같이 쓰지 않아요. I have arrived yesterday.(X) / When have you started?(X)

points.title: 대화는 현재완료로 묻고 과거로 이어가기
points.body: Have you ever been to Cairns?로 경험을 물은 뒤, 자세한 이야기는 Yes, I went there last year.처럼 과거 시제로 해요.

points.title: 지금도 계속? 이미 끝?
points.body: I lived in Seoul for five years.는 지금은 서울에 안 산다는 뜻, I have lived in Sydney for two years.는 지금도 시드니에 산다는 뜻이에요.

formula: 과거: 주어 + 과거형 + yesterday / last ~ / ~ ago / in 2022
현재완료: 주어 + have / has + p.p. (때를 말하지 않을 때)
When + did + 주어 + 동사원형? (When + have p.p.? X)

mistakes.wrong: I have arrived in Sydney last week.
mistakes.right: I arrived in Sydney last week.
mistakes.why: last week처럼 끝난 때를 말하면 현재완료가 아니라 과거 시제를 써요.

mistakes.wrong: When have you started your new job?
mistakes.right: When did you start your new job?
mistakes.why: When(언제)은 끝난 때를 묻는 말이라 did + 동사원형으로 물어요.

mistakes.wrong: I have lived in Seoul for five years, but now I live in Sydney.
mistakes.right: I lived in Seoul for five years, but now I live in Sydney.
mistakes.why: 지금은 서울에 안 사니까 이미 끝난 일 → 과거 시제(lived)예요.

examples.en: I have lost my phone, so I need a new one.
examples.ko: 휴대폰을 잃어버려서 (지금 없어서) 새 게 필요해요.

examples.en: She came to Australia two years ago.
She has been in Australia for two years.
"Have you ever been to Cairns?" "Yes, I went there last year."
examples.ko: "케언즈 가 본 적 있어?" "응, 작년에 갔어."

examples.en: When did you start your new job?
I worked at a hotel in Seoul for three years, but now I work at a café.
examples.ko: 나는 서울에서 3년 동안 호텔에서 일했지만, 지금은 카페에서 일해요.

examples.en: We have finished the cleaning. The kitchen looks great.
examples.ko: 우리 청소 다 했어요. 부엌이 정말 깔끔해 보여요.

quiz.why: last night은 끝난 때 → 과거 시제 lost
since + 시점으로 지금까지 계속 → has + p.p.
When은 끝난 때를 물어서 did + 동사원형

quiz.sentence: I ___ to Uluru two years ago.
quiz.why: two years ago는 끝난 때 → 과거 시제 went

quiz.sentence: "Have you ever tried Tim Tams?" "Yes, I ___ some yesterday."
quiz.ko: "팀탐 먹어 본 적 있어?" "응, 어제 좀 먹었어."

quiz.answer: I started a new job last week.
choices: I have started a new job last week.
I started a new job last week.
I have start a new job last week.
I start a new job last week.
quiz.why: last week은 끝난 때 → 과거 시제 started

quiz.ko: 그는 호주에 산 지 5년 됐어요. (지금도 살아요)
quiz.answer: He has lived in Australia for five years.
choices: He lived in Australia for five years.
He has lived in Australia since five years.
He has lived in Australia for five years.
He lives in Australia for five years.
quiz.why: 지금도 계속 사니까 has + p.p. + for

quiz.answer: When did you take this photo?
choices: When have you taken this photo?
When did you took this photo?
When did you take this photo?

quiz.answer: We moved into this share house a month ago.
choices: We have moved into this share house a month ago.
We moved into this share house a month ago.
We move into this share house a month ago.
We did moved into this share house a month ago.
quiz.why: a month ago는 끝난 때 → 과거 시제 moved

quiz.answer: I have never seen a platypus.
choices: I have never saw a platypus.
I didn't never see a platypus.
I have never see a platypus.
I have never seen a platypus.
quiz.why: 경험(한 번도 없다)은 have never + p.p.(seen)

quiz.answer: Tom has broken his arm, so he isn't working this week.
choices: Tom has broke his arm, so he isn't working this week.
Tom have broken his arm, so he isn't working this week.
Tom has broken his arm yesterday, so he isn't working this week.
Tom has broken his arm, so he isn't working this week.
quiz.why: yesterday와 현재완료는 같이 못 써요. 때를 빼면 has + p.p.(broken)
